def _optimise(nodes,edges,source,sink):
    graph=MinCostFlow(nodes)
    indexes=[graph.add_edge(u,v,cap,cost) for u,v,cap,cost in edges]
    value,total=graph.solve(source,sink)
    return value,total,[i for i,index in enumerate(indexes) if graph.flow_on(index)]
```

def _optimise_networkx(nodes,edges,source,sink):
    import networkx as nx
    graph=nx.DiGraph()
    graph.add_nodes_from(range(nodes))
    for u,v,cap,cost in edges:
        if cap>0:
            graph.add_edge(u,v,capacity=cap,weight=cost)
    # max flow
    value=nx.maximum_flow_value(graph,source,sink,capacity='capacity')
    if not value: return 0,0,[]
    graph.nodes[source]['demand']=-value
    graph.nodes[sink]['demand']=value
    flow,total=nx.min_cost_flow(graph,capacity='capacity',weight='weight')
    chosen=[i for i,(u,v,cap,cost) in enumerate(edges) if flow.get(u,{}).get(v,0)>0]
    return value,int(total),chosen
```
